in_text_mentions: The child was placed supine with the neck extended, under general anesthesia. A transverse elliptical incision was made around the cervical fistulous opening, dissected deep to the subplatysmal plane. The dissection was continued superiorly, tunneling under the subplatysmal layer to follow the path of the fistulous tract. The second transverse incision was made just above the level of the hyoid in a stepladder fashion to facilitate further superior dissection (Fig.3).
